t: D.C. Divisions Memo Re Service Of Watchmen Armed

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4128
21.9.32 Date 17/10/32

D. C. (Divisions).

Please see attached correspondence.

In this case the proprietors of the property endeavoured
to obtain regular policemen, undoubtedly to enforce their
object. They were informed that the Police could only interfere
in the case of an imminent breach of the peace. Failing to get
policemen they have succeeded in getting the next best thing -
armed Police Watchmen.

In similar cases in future it would be well if watchman
(armed) are not supplied till the matter has been referred to
you for decision. It is not advisable that the Police should
be involved in disputes between landlords and tenants, except
to prevent an imminent breach of the peace.

Will you please arrange accordingly re supply of watchmen
(armed).

(Signed) F.W. Gerrard.
C. P.

------

D. C. (Crime).
Officer i/c Special Branch.
Divisional Officers & Chief Inspectors etc.,
i/c Districts.
A. C. (Sikhs).
A. C. (Chinese).

For information. Services of Watchmen (Armed)
to be refused in all such cases in future.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH SEP 22 1932 KmB）

W. O. Springfeld
Deputy Commissioner (Divisions).

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处。
编号 D 4128
日期 1932年9月21日 1932年10月17日

分区副总巡官：

请参见所附函件。

在本案中，该物业的业主试图调派正规警员，无疑是为了强行达成其目的。已告知他们，警方仅在即将发生破坏和平行为的情况下方可介入。由于未能获得警员，他们已成功获得了次优之选——武装警备员（Watchmen）。

今后在类似案件中，最好在事项呈报给您裁决之前，不予派遣武装警备员。除为防止即将发生的破坏和平行为外，警方不宜卷入房东与租客之间的纠纷。

请就此安排武装警备员的派遣事宜。

（签名）F.W. Gerrard。
警务处处长。

------

分区副总巡官（刑事）。
特别科科长。
各分区警官及总督察等，
各区负责人。
助理处长（锡克人）。
助理处长（华人）。

供知悉。今后在所有此类案件中，均拒绝提供武装警备员服务。

（印章：刑事处副警务处处长 1932年9月22日 KmB）

W. O. Springfeld
分区副总巡官。
